name: Glimmering Child
body:
GLIMMERING CHILD
CR 11

XP 12,800
CE Medium outsider (extraplanar, incorporeal)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, see invisibility; Perception +18; Aura dreamlost 60 ft.

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 22, flat-footed 15 (+5 deflection, +6 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 133 (14d10+56)
Fort +9, Ref +15, Will +12
Defensive Abilities incorporeal; Immune blindness, illusion effects, mind-affecting effects, poison; Resist electricity 10, force 10, sonic 10

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee incorporeal touch +20 (4d8 force plus impressing touch)
Special Attacks aether globe (DC 22), ectoplasmic shift, impressing touch
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 14th; concentration +19)

Constant—see invisibility
At will—greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only), telekinesis
3/day—dream, etheric shards (DC 19), greater oneiric horror (DC 20), mirage arcana (DC 21), phantasmal killer (DC 20), phantasmal web (DC 21), scripted hallucination (DC 21), spell turning
1/day—greater possession (DC 22), nightmare (DC 20), subjective reality

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 22, Con 18, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 21
Base Atk +14; CMB +20; CMD 35
Feats Ability Focus (dreamlost aura), Dodge, Flyby Attack, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Spell Focus (illusion)
Skills Intimidate +22, Knowledge (planes) +18, Perception +18, Perform (any one) +22, Spellcraft +18, Stealth +23, Use Magic Device +22
Languages telepathy 120 ft.

Aether Globe (Su)

Once per minute as a standard action, a glimmering child may create a 10-foot sphere of swirling aether within 120 feet. A glimmering child may spend a move or standard action to move the aether globe 60 feet in any direction. Any creature which starts its turn within the aether globe or tries to move through the aether globe takes 8d8 force damage and is affected as the glimmering child’s impressing touch ability (Reflex save for half damage and to negate the impressing touch effect). A glimmering child may only have one aether globe active at a time.

Dreamlost Aura (Su)

A glimmering child can radiate a 60-foot-radius aura of hallucinogenic aether as a free action. Creatures within the affected area must succeed at a DC 24 Will save or take a –2 penalty to attack rolls, caster level checks, Intelligence-based skill checks, and Wisdom-based skill checks for as long as they remain in the aura and for 1d4 rounds thereafter. An affected creature’s movement speed is halved for as long as they are affected. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by the same glimmering child’s aura for 24 hours. The save is Charisma-based.

Ectoplasmic Shift (Su)

A glimmering child can push through the ectoplasmic veil to temporarily assume a physical form made of ectoplasm. As a swift action, the glimmering child can become corporeal for 1d4 rounds. It can return to its incorporeal form as a free action. Once its ectoplasmic form’s duration ends, the glimmering child cannot assume that form again for 1d4 rounds. While in ectoplasmic form, the glimmering child loses the incorporeal ability (including its deflection bonus to AC) and gains a +8 natural armor bonus to AC, and a Strength score equal to its Dexterity score

The AC for a typical glimmering child in ectoplasmic form is 25.

Impressing Touch (Su)

A creature damaged by a glimmering child’s touch attack takes a –2 penalty to all Will saves for 1 minute. During this time, the glimmering child ignores any immunity to illusions or mind-affecting effects the target may possess.

ABOUT

A mane of glittering rainbow hair enshrouds the vacant eye sockets and gaping mouth of this iridescent horror, these locks drifting as if tossed by invisible current. The being’s waifish body extends into overlong limbs and fingers, its rainbow skin sparkling like water under a midday sun.

Though not physically frail, a glimmering child much prefers to use its illusions and ranged assaults in combat, tossing foes about and relishing in their ethereal confusion.
